about.title: About Me
about.bio: 9 years of experience in Front-End Development. I have a knack for solving complex challenges and finding novel solutions. I have expertise in mobile-first development, responsive design, and web accessibility standards. I completed projects in the past while collaborating with designers and back-end developers. I am dedicated to doing a good job at all times and I pay great attention to detail.
